python3 << 'EOF'
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = Image.open('/tmp/fig1_new.png')
arr = np.array(img)

# Find non-white rows (threshold: not all pixels near-white)
row_means = arr.mean(axis=(1, 2))
non_white = row_means < 250

# Find first and last non-white rows
rows = np.where(non_white)[0]
top = max(0, rows[0] - 15)  # small padding
bottom = min(arr.shape[0], rows[-1] + 15)

cropped = arr[top:bottom, :, :]
h, w = cropped.shape[:2]
print(f"Original: {arr.shape[1]}x{arr.shape[0]}")
print(f"Cropped: {w}x{h}")
print(f"New aspect ratio: {w/h:.2f}:1")

cropped_img = Image.fromarray(cropped)
cropped_img.save('/tmp/fig1_cropped.png', dpi=(300, 300))
EOF
